event.title: Ninth Woman Found as Ongoing Investigation Continues in South Africa
event.canonical_title: Ninth Woman Found as Ongoing Investigation Continues in South Africa
event.summary: South African authorities have discovered the body of a ninth woman, all victims aged in their 20s and 30s, in a series of killings occurring on the outskirts of Johannesburg over the past two months. While police are investigating the cases, they have warned against prematurely linking all the incidents, as many women in the area express fear regarding their safety.

timeline.title: Three Arrested in Connection with Series of Killings of Women in South Africa
timeline.summary: Two women and a man have been arrested in connection with one of several recent killings of women in South Africa, which has raised significant concern over violence against women in the country. The arrests occurred on the outskirts of Johannesburg, where multiple incidents have been reported in recent months.
